changelog.name: v1.0 Initial Release
changelog.body:
This is the first release. It's an Android port of the iOS jailbreak tweak BatteryBuddy (https://github.com/kissalexandra/BatteryBuddy). It runs as an Xposed-style module for Vector / LSPosed and targets ColorOS SystemUI.

Features

- Battery with a face: The stock status bar battery icon becomes a rounded battery with a face and a terminal nub.
  - The face is happy, neutral or sad depending on charge level.
  - Below the low-battery threshold it shows dead "X eyes".
  - It is always happy while charging.
- Charging icon: You can keep ColorOS's own bolt or swap it for a plug and cord glyph.
- Color themes: There are four themes: System (follows ColorOS), Light, Dark and Custom (your own hex colors). The battery and the charging icon each get their own theme.
- Adjustable settings: The companion app lets you set the outline thickness and the happy, neutral and sad mood thresholds.
- Live preview: The companion app shows a preview of your actual battery state with your settings applied, before you save.

readme:
# BatteryBuddy

A port of [BatteryBuddy](https://github.com/kissalexandra/BatteryBuddy) — the cute battery-indicator jailbreak tweak for iOS — to Android, specifically ColorOS's SystemUI. An Xposed-style module for [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) / LSPosed. - Replaces the stock battery icon with a rounded body, a face, and a terminal nub — happy, neutral, sad, or a dead "X eyes" look below a configurable low-battery threshold. Always happy while charging. - Optionally replaces the charging bolt next to it with a plug/cord glyph. - Four color themes — **System** (follows ColorOS's own theme), **Light**, **Dark**, or **Custom** (your own hex colors) — for the battery and the charging icon independently. - Outline thickness and the three mood-band thresholds (happy / neutral / sad) are all adjustable from the companion app, with a live preview that reflects your actual battery state before you save. ## Requirements - Rooted device, ColorOS SystemUI (built against `HorizontalBatteryContentDrawable`, ColorOS's own battery icon drawable class — other OEM skins or AOSP SystemUI will not match and the module will simply decline to hook, leaving the stock icon alone) - Vector (or another LSPosed-compatible framework) with module scope for **System UI** - Android 8.1 or newer ## Install 1. Install the APK. 2. In Vector, enable **BatteryBuddy** with scope set to **System UI** only. 3. Restart System UI (or reboot) so the hook loads. 4. Open the BatteryBuddy app to set the theme, charging icon, thresholds, and outline thickness. Save, then restart System UI (the app can do this for you, given root) to see changes immediately — or just wait a few seconds for the next natural redraw. ## How it works The battery icon is a single custom `Drawable` ColorOS assigns to an `ImageView` in SystemUI. The hook intercepts that drawable's `draw(Canvas)` call and paints the entire icon itself — outline, fill, nub, and face — instead of letting ColorOS draw its own. The charging bolt lives in a separate `ImageView`; the hook intercepts its `setImageDrawable` call and, depending on the selected style, either swaps in a custom plug/cord `Drawable` or tints ColorOS's own bolt directly via `setColorFilter`. The companion app and the hook don't share a process, so settings cross between them through a `ContentProvider` rather than a shared-preferences file: this device's SELinux policy blocks a cross-app raw file read even with otherwise-open permissions, so the classic Xposed `XSharedPreferences` approach doesn't work here — the provider approach sidesteps that by keeping the raw read inside the owning process and only passing the already-read values over Binder. ## Build Needs a JDK and the Android SDK (build-tools and a platform). No Gradle. ```sh ./build.sh # produces BatteryBuddy.apk ./build.sh install # also installs it with adb ``` The APK is signed with a throwaway debug key at `build/debug.jks`, generated on first build if it doesn't already exist. ## Layout ``` src/io/github/edualexxis/batterybuddy/ Hook.java entry point; hooks the battery drawable and charging-icon view BatteryPaint.java the actual icon drawing code (no Xposed dependency — shared with the preview) PrefsProvider.java ContentProvider bridging the companion app's settings to the hook SettingsActivity.java companion app BatteryPreviewView.java the live preview shown in the companion app MoodRangeSlider.java the banded range slider for the mood thresholds stubs/ compile-time stubs of the Xposed API (not shipped) ``` ## Credits Ported from [kissalexandra/BatteryBuddy](https://github.com/kissalexandra/BatteryBuddy) (archived), the original iOS jailbreak tweak. The battery body, face, and the charging plug/cord glyph are all redrawn here to match that design — including the plug traced directly from its `StatusBarCharger.png` asset — but every line of Java/Android code in this repo was written independently for this port. ## License GPL-3.0, same as the original project this is a port of. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

# 电池伙伴

[BatteryBuddy](https://github.com/kissalexandra/BatteryBuddy)（适用于 iOS 的可爱电池指示器越狱调整）到 Android（特别是 ColorOS 的 SystemUI）的端口。 [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) / LSPod 的 Xposed 风格模块。 - 用圆形主体、脸部和终端小块替换库存电池图标 - 快乐、中性、悲伤或死“X 眼”外观低于可配置的低电池阈值。充电时永远快乐。 - 可以选择用插头/电线标志符号替换旁边的充电螺栓。 - 四种颜色主题 - **系统**（遵循 ColorOS 自己的主题）、**浅色**、**深色**或**自定义**（您自己的十六进制颜色）- 独立用于电池和充电图标。 - 轮廓粗细和三个情绪范围阈值（快乐/中性/悲伤）均可通过配套应用程序进行调整，并在保存之前实时预览反映您的实际电池状态。 ## 要求 - Root设备，ColorOS SystemUI（针对“HorizontalBatteryContentDrawable”构建，ColorOS自己的电池图标可绘制类 - 其他 OEM 皮肤或 AOSP SystemUI 将不匹配，模块将简单地拒绝挂钩，而仅保留库存图标） - Vector（或另一个 LSPod 兼容框架），具有 **系统 UI** 的模块范围 - Android 8.1 或更高版本 ## 安装 1.安装APK。 2. 在 Vector 中，启用 **BatteryBuddy**，并将范围设置为仅 **系统 UI**。 3. 重新启动系统 UI（或重新引导）以便加载挂钩。 4. 打开BatteryBuddy应用程序设置主题、充电图标、阈值和轮廓粗细。保存，然后重新启动系统 UI（应用程序可以为您执行此操作，给定 root 权限）以立即查看更改 - 或者只需等待几秒钟以进行下一次自然重画。 ## 它是如何工作的 电池图标是 ColorOS 分配给 SystemUI 中的“ImageView”的单个自定义“Drawable”。该钩子拦截该可绘制对象的“draw(Canvas)”调用并绘制整个图标本身 - 轮廓、填充、小块和面 - 而不是让 ColorOS 绘制自己的图标。充电螺栓位于单独的“ImageView”中；该钩子拦截其“setImageDrawable”调用，并根据所选样式，交换自定义插头/线“Drawable”或直接通过“setColorFilter”为 ColorOS 自己的螺栓着色。 配套应用程序和挂钩不共享进程，因此设置通过“ContentProvider”而不是共享首选项文件在它们之间交叉：该设备的 SELinux 策略会阻止跨应用程序原始文件读取，即使具有其他开放权限，因此经典的 Xpose“XSharedPreferences”方法在这里不起作用 - 提供程序方法通过将原始读取保留在所属进程内并仅通过 Binder 传递已读取的值来回避这一点。 ## 构建 需要 JDK 和 Android SDK（构建工具和平台）。没有摇篮。 ````嘘 ./build.sh # 生成 BatteryBuddy.apk ./build.sh install # 也使用 adb 安装它 ```` APK 使用“build/debug.jks”处的一次性调试密钥进行签名，如果尚不存在，则在第一次构建时生成该密钥。 ## 布局 ```` src/io/github/edualexxis/batterybuddy/ Hook.java 入口点；挂钩电池可绘制和充电图标视图 BatteryPaint.java 实际的图标绘制代码（无 Xposed 依赖项 — 与预览版共享） PrefsProvider.java ContentProvider 将配套应用程序的设置桥接到挂钩 SettingsActivity.java 配套应用程序 BatteryPreviewView.java 配套应用程序中显示的实时预览 MoodRangeSlider.java 情绪阈值的带状范围滑块 Xpose API 的存根/编译时存根（未提供） ```` ## 学分 移植自 [kissalexandra/BatteryBuddy](https://github.com/kissalexandra/BatteryBuddy)（已存档），原始的 iOS 越狱调整。电池主体、正面和充电插头/电线字形均在此处重新绘制以匹配该设计 - 包括他直接从其“StatusBarCharger.png”资源中跟踪插件 - 但此存储库中的每一行 Java/Android 代码都是为此端口独立编写的。 ## 许可证 GPL-3.0，与原始项目相同，这是一个端口。请参阅[许可证]（许可证）。
